title: A notification failure alerts the administrator
narrative: As Lori and Steve, we want a disabled notification permission to be visible to both of us and to alert Lori exactly once.

watchos.reason: watchOS is deferred until after the iOS MVP.

environments.connected-emulators: Fresh Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Functions emulators running production rules and function code.
environments.ios-simulator: Pinned iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5 Simulator using the production notification authorization path.
environments.captured-sms: A local Twilio-compatible HTTP endpoint validates and records the production Function request; it does not claim carrier delivery.

preconditions: Backend: fresh Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Functions emulators with production rules and function code
Data: Lori creates and publishes the schedule and SMS destination through visible dashboard controls
Identity: run-specific Google-provider identities use the Firebase Auth Emulator
Device: fresh iPhone 17 on iOS 26.5 with notification authorization not yet determined
SMS: the production alert Function calls a captured Twilio-compatible HTTP endpoint

steps.description: Lori publishes a schedule with an SMS alert destination

claims.text: The schedule is published through the dashboard
The administrator SMS destination is saved through the dashboard
claims.assertion: setup.spec.ts checks the saved SMS field

steps.description: Steve starts the patient sign-in flow

claims.text: Google is the visible patient sign-in action
claims.assertion: NotificationFailureUITests checks the Google sign-in button

steps.description: MediNag signs into the isolated Firebase Auth Emulator identity

claims.text: The authentication progress state is visible
Steve explicitly continues to schedule selection
Lori's published plan is visible from Firebase
The published plan identifies the medication

steps.description: The iPhone follows Lori's schedule before requesting permission

claims.text: The medication event arrives through the Firestore listener
The app offers the notification permission action

steps.description: iOS asks whether MediNag may send notifications

claims.text: The notification permission sheet is rendered by iOS
The system offers a Don't Allow action
claims.assertion: NotificationFailureUITests checks the system denial button

steps.description: Steve sees that medication notifications are disabled

claims.text: The patient sees that notifications are disabled
The patient is told to enable notifications in Settings
The client-visible failure is written through Firestore
claims.assertion: NotificationFailureUITests waits for the incident-created acknowledgement

steps.description: Lori sees the incident and its captured SMS result

claims.text: The dashboard shows the same notification authorization incident
claims.assertion: completion.spec.ts checks the incident code and message

claims.text: The provider acceptance, message ID, and single attempt are recorded
claims.assertion: completion.spec.ts checks the administrator incident card

claims.text: Exactly one authenticated Twilio-compatible request is captured
claims.assertion: completion.spec.ts validates the sole captured request
